description: The crypto market on StockMap's coin map: the 250 largest coins by market value (CoinGecko), grouped by theme (layer 1, stablecoins, exchange tokens, memes and more), with Bitcoin's share of all crypto, each theme's move over 24 hours and the biggest moves. Its card draws the coins as StockMap's heatmap, Bitcoin to scale and the stablecoins at the edge, or as bubbles, live. Market data with no call on any coin. Each answer carries the stamp, the sources and the not-advice line.
